Contacting me

When enabled, the contact form sends your name, reply email, chosen topic, and message to Braj through the hosting mail service. Messages are not stored in the website database. Cloudflare Turnstile processes verification information to help prevent automated abuse. Temporary, salted identifiers derived from IP and email addresses enforce rate limits; expired entries are removed on subsequent requests. Hosting and email providers may retain their own operational records. You can also contact Braj using the direct email, WhatsApp, or LinkedIn links.

Site features

This site does not add analytics trackers or advertising scripts. Essential session cookies protect contact submissions and owner sign-in. Turnstile loads near the enabled contact form. Hosting providers may process ordinary request information to serve and protect the website. The font and visual assets are hosted with the site.

External websites

Project links, archive references, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp take you to external services with their own privacy practices. Historical project references describe earlier contributions and may differ from the current state of those websites.

Contact

For questions about the website or information presented here, email brajkishorpandey@gmail.com.
